topic: Quick self-check: how ready is your home today?

content.hook: POV: the power cuts out. Is your home ready?

slides.title: *POV:* power cuts out. Is your home ready?
slides.body: A 60-second self-check. No stress, just honest answers.

slides.title: Can you cover *3 days* of water?
slides.body: Think about 3 litres per person per day. Count what you have right now.

slides.title: Phones down: where do you *meet*?
slides.body: Agree a meeting point and one out-of-area contact. Make sure everyone knows both.

content.caption:
POV: the power cuts out and you realise you've never checked your home preparedness. Good news: a quick self-check takes a minute.

1. Water. Official guidance points to about 3 litres per person per day. Count what you have at home right now.
2. Contact. If phones and internet go down, does your family know where to meet and who to call outside your area?
3. Bag. Could you leave the house in 15 minutes with documents, cash and essentials?

Any gap is fine. It just tells you where to start. Save this and run through it with your household.

Water, contact plan or go bag — which is weakest?
